title: Is Splinting After Ulnar Nerve Transposition Necessary?
official: Is Splinting After Ulnar Nerve Transposition Necessary?
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn whether patient recovery after ulnar nerve transposition (UNT) requires a splint. The main questions it aims to answer are:

* Does the effect that early versus delayed mobilization after UNT have on patient sleep quality differ?
* What are the medical complications, reoperations, and timeline of returning to work that result from this procedure like?

Participants will be placed in a stiff splint (that limits elbow movement) or no splint (that allows for earlier elbow movement) after this surgery. Participants will report their recovery through surveys measuring physical function, pain, and sleep. Researchers will compare the results between the two types of splinting.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Over 18 years old
* Indicated for Ulnar Nerve Transposition
* Able and willing to complete online questionnaires
* Able and willing to provide written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Additional procedures to be performed on ipsilateral or contralateral extremity
